column1: # The texts docsys releases wrote for the assets it owns: asset <TAB> sha256 of the text <TAB> the first release that wrote it.
# `docsys upgrade` refreshes a file whose text, the tree's generated preamble set aside, is one of these; any other text is its owner's.
# A relay is hashed without its `# docsys-template:` line and with its root default read as `docs`, the two things a render varies.
